intro.en: Doctor Azad has given Hamo some advice, and the neighbours keep bringing him jars of honey. In the morning one jar is empty. Read the evidence on the board, answer each question, then say who ate the honey.

about.en: Who is ill, or says he is.
The young deer, who is always hungry.
Nazê’s son from next door, nine years old.

line.en: The doctor says honey is forbidden at night.
No, Hevalo is innocent. He only eats apples.
Yes. Baran is honest, and I understand him.
But there’s honey on your moustache, Xalo!
That’s not honey! It’s… medicine. I’m better!
I’m innocent! Do you believe me?
Yes, and some honey too… no, honey is forbidden!
Hevalo is looking at you. He doesn’t believe it.

prompt.en: What was empty in the morning?
What does Hamo say about Baran?

solution.en: The doctor forbade honey at night, and in the morning a jar was empty. Hevalo only eats apples, and Baran is honest. Hamo says it is medicine on his moustache, and nearly asks for honey with his medicine. Hamo ate the honey.

hints.en: Read what each suspect says, and what the others say about them.
One of the cards is what was on someone’s face in the morning.
Which of the suspects has a moustache?
